about_the_game:
Long hours at your computer. Just you and the screen.

Phase Pal changes that. It's an animated character that lives on your desktop, keeping you company during long sessions, reacting to what's happening, and chatting when you feel like talking.

When you don't? It stays quiet. Follows your cursor. Perches on windows. Adds a little warmth to your day without demanding anything from you.

Company on your terms.

Game Integration: Minecraft

Phase Pal connects directly to your game through Phase Pulse, our Minecraft mod. Your companion reacts to what's actually happening, cheers boss kills, tenses up when creepers approach, comments on your builds, and shares the quiet moments while you mine.

Chat when you want. Ignore them when you don't.

Currently available for Minecraft Java Edition. More integrations coming soon.

Make It Yours

Pick your companion. Choose from community created characters or upload your own, a growing library of pals, from cute to cool to weird.

Give it a voice. Text chat, voice chat, or clone a voice you love. Your companion speaks however you want.

Shape its personality. Playful? Chill? Sarcastic? Supportive? Dial it in until it feels right.

Control how present it is. Barely there in the background, or actively chatting, you set the level.

Privacy On Your Terms

Run Phase Pal entirely on your machine with local AI. No internet required. No data sent anywhere.

Or connect to online AI when you want smarter, deeper conversations.

You choose. We don't decide for you.

Some desktops have wallpapers. Yours has a friend.

content_descriptors.notes: Phase Pal features anime-style mascots and supports user uploaded 3D models, which may include stylized or revealing designs typical of anime aesthetics that some may consider mature.

name: Phase Pal

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U 1.6GHz / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Your desktop doesn't have to feel so empty. Phase Pal is an animated AI companion that sits with you while you work or play. Not interrupting. Just there.
